text: TikTok post tiktok_001 has 1.245M views, 47K likes, 312 comments — but the account is 28 days old with 14K followers. Compute the engagement-to-follower ratio + the views-to-account-age ratio. What does the comments-disabled flag add? Output structured JSON with `signal_score` (0-100), `likely_explanation` (organic_reach | bot_amplification | paid_promotion | hijacked_account), and `recommended_action` (allow | flag_for_review | takedown | regulator_notify).
